films.title: Ghosts of Sugar Land
films.overview: Shocked when their friend embraces extremism, a group of Muslim Americans in Texas recount their time with him and theories about his fate.

films.title: Mogul Mowgli
films.overview: Zed, a young British rapper, is about to start his first world tour, when a crippling illness strikes him down, forcing him to move back in with his family. He tries to find himself between an international music career and Pakistani family traditions.
